answer: The ferrous graph is validated at intake and the walnut frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and saffron anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Running 130 accounts means paying 169 times the fee up front and waiting 10 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
